{{Quote|I will not harm you. You are in Mahara Kesh, the Temple of Healing. My name is Calleh, a healer.|Calleh|<ref name="DotJ5" />}}
'''Calleh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] healer of the [[Je'daii Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] who was the mate of a fellow Selkath, [[Naro]]. The two Je'daii jointly held the position of [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Master]] of [[Mahara Kesh]], the [[Je'daii Temples|Temple]] of Healing on Tython. In [[25,793 BBY]], Calleh and Naro helped the other Temple Masters on the [[Je'daii Council]] quell a [[Force Storm (Tython)|Force Storm]] that was ravaging the world, and Calleh tended to those who were wounded in the storm's aftermath.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Will you kill me now?''"<br />"''No, child.''"<br />"''Oh&hellip;|Calleh and Xesh|<ref name="DotJ5" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|female]],<ref name="DotJ5" /> Calleh was trained in the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Je'daii Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], and eventually became the mate of a Selkath male by the name of [[Naro]]. Both were [[Doctor/Legends|healers]], and by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,793 BBY]], Calleh and Naro were serving as joint [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Masters]] of [[Mahara Kesh]], the [[Je'daii Temples|Temple]] of Healing.<ref name="DotJ0" /> That year, the planet was embroiled in an immense [[Force Storm (Tython)|Force Storm]], and Calleh, Naro, and the other Temple Masters&mdash;who collectively formed the [[Je'daii Council]] were forced to join together and lend their strength to Temple Master [[Quan-Jang]], who shifted the planet back towards the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] and into balance.<ref name="DotJ5" />

Shortly afterward, the Force-sensitive offworlder [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] was brought to Mahara Kesh along with several other Je'daii who had been injured while capturing Xesh, including Quan-Jang. Calleh tended to the wounds of Xesh and the [[Je'daii Journeyer]] [[Sek'nos Rath]], and she was checking up on Xesh when the young man awoke. Calleh expressed sympathy for the hard life Xesh had led, as was clearly visible by the numerous scars that covered his body, and the Selkath explained that the stranger was at Mahara Kesh. Calleh and Naro continued to tend to the injured over the next ten [[Standard day/Legends|days]], at which [[Time/Legends|time]] the Council decided to exile Xesh&mdash;whose powerful presence in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] had caused the recent storm&mdash;to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Bogan]].<ref name="DotJ5" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|All of these old scars. You have led a brutal life. More than the Abyss did this to you. Poor child.|Calleh|<ref name="DotJ5" />}}
A female Selkath, Calleh possessed a single tendril that extended from the back of her head, and she had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and skin that was patterned in shades of dark and light blue on her head. The rest of Calleh's skin, however, was a pale grey-green color, and she had two black-and-silver rings looped through the lobes on the side of her head. She felt great sympathy for Xesh when she realized how violent his life had been, and Calleh was a skilled and knowledgeable healer, holding the position of Temple Master at the Temple of Healing.<ref name="DotJ5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Calleh was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|preview issue 0]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series,<ref name="DotJ0" /> and she made her first appearance in the series' [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5|fifth issue]].<ref name="DotJ5" />
